_transfer calls swapBack while state changes and external calls occur

addLiquidity invokes the external Uniswap router addLiquidityETH
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls back into the external pair contract via sync()

swapBack resets the marketing token fee bucket to zero
swapBack resets the liquidity token fee bucket to zero
swapBack resets the dev token fee bucket to zero

to is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer
amount is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer and its fee arithmetic
contractTokenBalance is a local used solely inside swapBack
fees is the fee-arithmetic local computed in _transfer
takeFee is the branch-control local of _transfer
totalTokensToSwap is a local aggregate computed only in swapBack
liquidityTokens is a swapBack-only local
amountToSwapForETH is a swapBack-only local
initialETHBalance is a swapBack-only snapshot local
ethBalance is a swapBack-only local
ethForMarketing is a swapBack-only allocation local
ethForDev is the value passed to the devWallet low-level call
ethForLiquidity is a swapBack-only allocation local
percent is only meaningful inside manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens
tokenAmount is only meaningful inside swapTokensForEth
ethAmount is only meaningful inside addLiquidity
liquidityPairBalance is a local of the auto burn routine
amountToBurn is the burn amount local of the auto burn routine
path is a local swap path built for the router call
account is only meaningful inside excludeFromFees
newOwner is only meaningful inside transferOwnership
newWallet is only meaningful inside updateDevWallet
newMarketingWallet is only meaningful inside updateMarketingWallet
